target_customer: Women in India with thyroid conditions, paying for a holistic care program; doctors use the software
problem: Many thyroid patients on medication still have symptoms such as fatigue and weight issues, and doctors lack tools to find root causes.
business_model: Consumer health subscription or program combining diagnosis, nutrition, supplements and medicine (exact pricing not found)

founders.name: Piyush Vishwakarma
founders.background_notes: YC page says he now heads B2B products at Tata 1mg.

technical_complexity.rationale: Telehealth and care workflow software is standard; the hard part was clinical protocol and operations, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical protocol and brand were the only assets; no data or regulatory advantage shown.

market_need_then: Company states about 60 percent of women on thyroid medication have unresolved symptoms; another source cites 40 million thyroid patients in India (search summary).

branding.domain_note: jeevamhealth.com now redirects to an unrelated Yemen tourism site, so the domain lapsed or was sold.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; the domain now points elsewhere.

outcome_analysis: Jeevam raised YC money in 2021 and a pre-seed round reported in July 2022, grew to a listed team of 25, then went inactive. No shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public; the company's domain now redirects to an unrelated site and the CEO moved to Tata 1mg. Could_not_raise_next_round is an inference from having no round after 2022, not a stated reason.
notes: The YourStory 150K dollar figure is from a search result, the page itself returned 403. VCBacked and a directory report a 550K dollar round around July 2022 while Venture Intelligence says undisclosed; amount left null. Company site redirects to an unrelated domain. No dated competitors found; competitor search returned only the company itself and later diagnostics players. Education not found.
